segments.speaker: EVA
segments.text: Hello, you're speaking with EVA, Telenet's digital assistant. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, my bill is way higher than normal. Over two hundred euros! I really don't understand this.
segments.log: Angry and confused about the bill. Red: service first, no offer.

segments.speaker: EVA
segments.text: I understand. Let me check. Your bill is usually about 118 euros. This month there's 96 euros extra for mobile data used in Switzerland, on the fourteenth and fifteenth of September. Switzerland is outside the EU, so that data isn't included in your plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Switzerland... Ah. Right. The holiday. My daughter was streaming all weekend in the chalet.
segments.log: Voice relaxes, laughter starts. Amber: problem not yet confirmed as solved.

segments.speaker: EVA
segments.text: So the amount is correct. Is it clear now where it comes from?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, it's clear. Still quite a lot of money for some data. We go there every year, so I'll have to watch out.
segments.chartCallout: Words alone: 38%, no offer · Voice: 88%, relieved and laughing
segments.log: Words sound hesitant, but the voice is relieved and laughing. Problem solved + EVA score 78%: green.

segments.speaker: EVA
segments.text: Since you travel there every year: our travel data option gives you data outside the EU at a fixed price, so this won't happen again. Shall I add it to your plan? You can switch it off anytime, free of charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, please. Add it. I will definitely need it with my daughter streaming all the time.
segments.log: Customer explicitly accepts the offer. Sale executed.

segments.speaker: EVA
segments.text: Done, it's active from today. Your confirmation is in the Telenet app. Have a nice day!

rules:
GREEN  = problem_solved AND eva_score > 70% AND guardrails_ok  → one live offer from next best action
AMBER  = 30% ≤ eva_score ≤ 70% OR (eva_score > 70% AND NOT problem_solved)  → no live offer; digital offer after 48–72 h if no new contact
RED    = eva_score < 30%  → no offer; focus on solving the problem
HANDOVER = RED still after EVA's explanation OR recognition_failures ≥ 2  → advisor with call summary, no offer
guardrails_ok = recognition_failures < 2 AND no_open_complaint AND last_tNPS ≥ 7 AND marketing_consent AND no_decline_6m
eva_score = 0.2 × text_score + 0.8 × voice_score   (illustrative weights)
